description.zh: 长城是中国最具代表性的历史建筑，绵延超过21,000公里。建于多个朝代，主要段落修建于明代。慕田峪和司马台等段落保存完好，可俯瞰壮观的山地景色。
description.en: The Great Wall stretches over 21,000 km and is China's most iconic monument. Built across dynasties, the best-preserved Ming-era sections at Mutianyu and Simatai offer stunning mountain panoramas.

en: UNESCO Heritage
Historic Monument
Ming Dynasty

zh: 世界最长的人工建筑，总长逾2万公里
慕田峪、司马台等段落风景各异
山脊上蜿蜒的视觉冲击无与伦比
en: World's longest man-made structure, over 20,000 km
Scenic sections at Mutianyu, Simatai and more
Unmatched visual drama along the mountain ridgeline

tips.zh: 避开八达岭拥挤人潮，选择慕田峪或司马台段，体验更真实；秋季红叶时节景色最美。
tips.en: Skip the crowded Badaling and opt for Mutianyu or Simatai for a more authentic experience. Autumn foliage season is spectacular.

description.zh: 故宫是世界上保存最完整的古代皇宫建筑群，占地72万平方米，拥有近万间房屋。自1420年起作为明清两代皇宫使用长达近600年，现为故宫博物院。
description.en: The Forbidden City is the world's largest and best-preserved imperial palace complex, covering 72 ha with nearly 10,000 rooms. It served as the Ming and Qing imperial palace for nearly 600 years from 1420.

en: UNESCO Heritage
Imperial Palace
Museum

zh: 世界最大的宫殿建筑群，故宫博物院
明清两朝24位皇帝的居所
en: World's largest palace complex and premier museum
Home to 24 emperors across the Ming and Qing dynasties
Over 1.8 million artefacts in the collection

admission.zh: 旺季60元，淡季40元（需网上预约）

tips.zh: 门票必须提前在官网预约，现场不售票。建议早上开门时入场避开人流。
tips.en: Tickets must be booked on the official website in advance — no on-the-day sales. Arrive at opening time to beat the crowds.

description.zh: 天坛建于1420年，是明清两代皇帝祭天祈谷的神圣场所，占地273公顷。其建筑布局体现了古人「天圆地方」的宇宙观，是中国古代建筑与园林设计的杰作，1998年被列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: Built in 1420, the Temple of Heaven served as the imperial altar where Ming and Qing emperors conducted Heaven-worship ceremonies and prayers for good harvests. Its 273-hectare complex embodies the ancient cosmological belief that heaven is round and earth is square, and was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1998.

en: UNESCO Heritage
Ming Dynasty
Imperial Altar

location.zh: 北京市崇文区（东城区南部）

zh: 祈年殿——三重蓝色琉璃瓦攒尖圆形大殿，明清建筑极致
圜丘坛——皇帝冬至祭天之所，体验天地之间的神圣感
回音壁——低声细语可沿墙传至数十米外，堪称声学奇迹
en: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests — iconic triple-eaved circular hall with blue glazed tiles
Circular Mound Altar — where emperors performed the winter solstice Heaven ceremony
Echo Wall — whispers travel around the circular wall to listeners far away

admission.zh: 公园门票15元；联票（含主要建筑）34元

tips.zh: 早晨入园可见北京市民在古柏间打太极、唱京剧，充满生活气息。地铁5号线天坛东门站下车最方便。
tips.en: Arrive early morning to catch locals practising tai chi and Beijing opera under ancient cypress trees. Take subway Line 5 to Tiantan Dongmen station.

description.zh: 颐和园是中国保存最完整的皇家园林，以昆明湖和万寿山为骨架，融合湖光山色与亭台楼阁，是中国古典园林艺术的巅峰之作。始建于1750年，后经重建，1998年列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: The Summer Palace is China's best-preserved imperial garden, harmoniously blending the natural landscape of Longevity Hill and man-made Kunming Lake with palaces, temples, and pavilions. First built in 1750 and largely restored in 1886, it was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1998.

en: UNESCO Heritage
Imperial Garden
Qing Dynasty

zh: 昆明湖——面积2.2平方公里，由人工挖掘而成
长廊——全长728米，绘有14,000余幅彩画，世界最长有顶走廊
十七孔桥——横跨南湖岛，造型典雅，是园内标志性景观
en: Kunming Lake — 2.2 km² man-made lake, accounting for three-quarters of the park's area
Long Corridor — 728 m covered walkway adorned with over 14,000 painted scenes
Seventeen-Arch Bridge — elegant stone bridge connecting the South Lake Island

admission.zh: 旺季30元，淡季20元；联票（含园内景点）60/50元
admission.en: Park entry ¥20–30; all-inclusive ticket ¥50–60 depending on season

tips.zh: 冬季昆明湖结冰可滑冰，别有趣味。地铁4号线北宫门站或新街口方向可直达，避开旺季周末。
tips.en: In winter, Kunming Lake freezes and locals take to the ice. Take subway Line 4 to Beigongmen station. Avoid weekend peak hours in summer.

description.zh: 明十三陵是明朝13位皇帝的陵寝群，坐落于北京昌平区天寿山南麓，依风水原则选址布局，占地逾120平方公里。2003年作为「明清皇家陵寝」系列遗产的重要组成部分列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: The Ming Tombs is a complex of thirteen imperial mausoleums of the Ming Dynasty, nestled against Tianshou Mountain in Changping District. Laid out according to feng shui principles and covering over 120 km², it was inscribed as part of the 'Imperial Tombs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties' UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2003.

en: UNESCO Heritage
Imperial Mausoleum
Ming Dynasty

location.zh: 北京市昌平区天寿山南麓，市区西北约42公里
location.en: Changping District, ~42 km northwest of central Beijing

zh: 长陵——规模最大、保存最好，供奉永乐皇帝，棱恩殿气势雄伟
定陵——唯一对外开放地下宫殿，出土大量明代文物
神道——两侧排列石像生，气势庄严肃穆
en: Changling Tomb — largest and best-preserved, housing Emperor Yongle's magnificent Ling'en Hall
Dingling Tomb — only excavated mausoleum with a fully accessible underground palace
Sacred Way — ceremonial road flanked by stone statues of animals and officials

admission.zh: 长陵、定陵各约30—60元；神道约35元
admission.en: Changling and Dingling each ~¥30–60; Sacred Way ~¥35

tips.zh: 长陵+定陵+神道是经典组合。可乘坐地铁昌平线至十三陵景区站再换乘景区内公交，也可参加一日游团。
tips.en: Changling + Dingling + Sacred Way is the classic combination. Take the Changping subway line to Shisanling Scenic Area station, then a local bus within the site.

description.zh: 周口店遗址位于北京西南约42公里处，是迄今发现的亚洲地区最重要的古人类遗址之一。自1929年起出土了距今约70万至20万年前的「北京人」化石及大量石器与用火证据，1987年列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: Located about 42 km southwest of Beijing, Zhoukoudian is one of Asia's most important palaeolithic sites. Since 1929, it has yielded fossils of Homo erectus pekinensis ('Peking Man') dating back 700,000–200,000 years, along with over 100,000 stone tools and evidence of early fire use. Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.

en: UNESCO Heritage
Palaeolithic Site
Prehistoric

location.zh: 北京市房山区周口店镇，市区西南约42公里
location.en: Zhoukoudian Town, Fangshan District, ~42 km southwest of central Beijing

zh: 出土迄今最丰富的直立人化石，改写人类演化史
发现超过10万件石器及灰烬层，证明人类最早用火
遗址博物馆展示完整的考古发掘与古人类生活复原
en: Richest known collection of Homo erectus fossils, rewriting human evolutionary history
Over 100,000 stone tools and ash deposits proving early controlled use of fire
On-site museum with reconstructions of Peking Man's daily life and excavation finds

tips.zh: 可与附近房山石花洞或云居寺结合游览。公共交通需在北京西站乘917路快速公交至房山后转乘。
tips.en: Combine with nearby Shihua Cave or Yunju Temple in Fangshan. From Beijing West Station take express bus 917 to Fangshan and transfer to a local bus.

description.zh: 北京是京杭大运河的北端起点，大运河北京段包括通惠河水系与什刹海地区的万宁桥、澄清上闸等核心遗产点。大运河全线于2014年整体列入世界遗产名录，是古代中国沟通南北的水利与漕运奇迹。
description.en: Beijing marks the northern terminus of the Grand Canal. The Beijing section includes Wanning Bridge and the Chengqing lock gates along the Tonghui River and Shichahai lake system, inscribed as part of the Grand Canal UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2014. This ancient waterway was the backbone of China's north-south trade and grain transport for centuries.

en: UNESCO Heritage
Canal
Yuan Dynasty

location.zh: 北京市西城区万宁桥（什刹海）及通州区通惠河沿线
location.en: Wanning Bridge area (Shichahai), Xicheng District, and Tongzhou District along the Tonghui River

zh: 万宁桥——建于元代初年，至今仍承担交通功能的千年古桥
澄清上闸（通惠河闸）——调节漕运水位的古代水利设施
通州大运河文化旅游景区——感受漕运文化与运河两岸风光
en: Wanning Bridge — Yuan Dynasty stone bridge still in daily use after 700 years
Chengqing Upper Lock Gate — ancient hydraulic sluice regulating boat traffic on the Tonghui River
Tongzhou Grand Canal Cultural Park — scenic riverside area celebrating the canal's history

admission.zh: 万宁桥及什刹海一带免费；通州运河文化景区部分区域收费
admission.en: Wanning Bridge and Shichahai area free; some sections of Tongzhou Canal Park may charge a fee

tips.zh: 万宁桥一带风景怡人，可结合什刹海胡同游览。通州段乘地铁6号线至通州北苑方向即可抵达。
tips.en: Wanning Bridge is best combined with a Shichahai hutong stroll. For the Tongzhou section, take subway Line 6 towards Tongzhou North Garden.

description.zh: 北京中轴线南起永定门，北至鼓楼、钟楼，全长7.8公里，由15处遗产要素构成，历经700余年形成，是中国历代都城规划的集大成之作。2024年7月在联合国教科文组织第46届世界遗产委员会会议上列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: The Beijing Central Axis stretches 7.8 km from Yongdingmen Gate in the south to the Drum and Bell Towers in the north, comprising 15 heritage components that took over 700 years to evolve. It embodies the ideal order of Chinese capital planning laid out in ancient texts, and was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in July 2024.

en: UNESCO Heritage
Urban Planning
Historic Architecture

location.zh: 北京市中心南北向主轴，永定门至鼓楼、钟楼
location.en: North–south spine of central Beijing, from Yongdingmen Gate to the Drum and Bell Towers

zh: 鼓楼与钟楼——中轴线北端，俯瞰北京胡同全景
天安门广场建筑群——人民英雄纪念碑、毛主席纪念堂等组成的国家礼仪空间
先农坛——皇帝亲耕的神圣场所，现存明代礼制建筑群
en: Drum and Bell Towers — northern anchor of the axis with panoramic hutong views
Tian'anmen Square Complex — national ceremonial space including the Monument to the People's Heroes
Altar of the God of Agriculture — Ming ceremonial complex where emperors performed ritual ploughing

admission.zh: 各组成部分票价不同；鼓楼约20元，正阳门约20元；天安门广场免费
admission.en: Each component priced separately; Drum Tower ~¥20, Zhengyangmen ~¥20; Tian'anmen Square is free

duration.zh: 全程步行半日至一整天
duration.en: Half day to a full day on foot

tips.zh: 可从永定门出发向北步行，依次游览正阳门、天安门、故宫、景山、万宁桥直至鼓楼，体验城市中轴全貌。
tips.en: Start at Yongdingmen and walk north through Zhengyangmen, Tian'anmen, the Forbidden City, Jingshan Hill, Wanning Bridge and ending at the Drum Tower for the full axis experience.

description.zh: 房山世界地质公园位于北京西南约40公里的房山区，地质遗迹跨越35亿年，以华北地区最大的岩溶洞穴群和「北京人」化石产地周口店遗址最为著名。2006年加入联合国教科文组织世界地质公园网络。
description.en: Located about 40 km southwest of central Beijing in Fangshan District, this UNESCO Global Geopark spans 3.5 billion years of geological heritage. It is famous for northern China's largest karst cave system and for containing the Zhoukoudian site where 'Peking Man' fossils were discovered. Admitted to the UNESCO Global Geoparks Network in 2006.

en: UNESCO Geopark
Karst Landscape
Prehistoric

location.zh: 北京市房山区，市区西南约40公里
location.en: Fangshan District, ~40 km southwest of central Beijing

zh: 石花洞——华北最大溶洞，七层结构发育，钟乳石景观壮观
银狐洞——超过10公里的地下河溶洞体系，可乘船游览地下河
十渡峡谷——拒马河穿越石灰岩峡谷，是北京周边最美自然风光之一
en: Shihua Cave — northern China's largest karst cave with seven underground levels
Yinhu Cave — over 10 km of explored passages including a 1 km underground river boat ride
Shidu Canyon — the Juma River cuts through limestone gorges, among Beijing's finest natural scenery

admission.zh: 石花洞约80元；银狐洞约80元；各景区单独购票
admission.en: Shihua Cave ~¥80; Yinhu Cave ~¥80; tickets purchased separately per attraction

tips.zh: 地质公园由多个景区组成，建议提前规划路线。从北京西站乘917路快速公交至房山，再转乘景区班车。十渡适合夏季漂流，石花洞全年开放。
tips.en: The geopark is spread across multiple sites — plan your route in advance. Take express bus 917 from Beijing West Station to Fangshan, then scenic-area shuttles. Shidu is great for summer rafting; Shihua Cave is open year-round.

description.zh: 延庆世界地质公园位于北京西北部延庆区，园内保存有华北地区规模最大的硅化木群落和大量晚侏罗世恐龙足迹化石，地质遗迹类型多样。2009年加入联合国教科文组织世界地质公园网络。
description.en: Yanqing UNESCO Global Geopark, in the northwestern Yanqing District of Beijing, preserves northern China's largest silicified wood deposit alongside hundreds of Late Jurassic dinosaur footprints. The park's diverse geological heritage includes volcanic rocks, mountain landscapes, and ancient river valleys. It joined the UNESCO Global Geoparks Network in 2009.

en: UNESCO Geopark
Dinosaur Footprints
Silicified Wood

location.zh: 北京市延庆区，市区西北约75公里
location.en: Yanqing District, ~75 km northwest of central Beijing

zh: 硅化木与恐龙足迹展厅——数百枚1.5亿年前晚侏罗纪恐龙足迹化石
龙庆峡——因峡谷风光秀丽而被誉为「北京的桂林」，冬季冰灯节享誉全国
古崖居——千年前岩居古村落遗址，神秘独特
en: Dinosaur Footprint Hall — hundreds of Late Jurassic footprints from theropods, sauropods and more
Longqing Gorge — dubbed 'Beijing's Guilin' for its limestone scenery; famous for its winter ice lantern festival
Guyaju Cliff Dwellings — mysterious ancient cliff-carved village dating back over a millennium

admission.zh: 龙庆峡约80元；古崖居约30元；地质博物馆免费
admission.en: Longqing Gorge ~¥80; Guyaju Cliff Dwellings ~¥30; Geopark Museum free

tips.zh: 延庆是2022年冬奥会举办地之一，交通便利。乘坐S2铁路或京张高铁可直达延庆站，冬季冰灯节（元旦至元宵节）是最热闹的时节。
tips.en: Yanqing hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics venues. Take the S2 rail line or the high-speed Jingzhang Railway directly to Yanqing station. The winter ice lantern festival (New Year to Lantern Festival) is a highlight.
